feature_queries.name: user_basics
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, DATEDIFF('day', u.CreationDate, e.timestamp) as user_age_days FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN users u ON u.Id = e.OwnerUserId

feature_queries.name: post_stats
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(p.Id) as n_posts, SUM(CASE WHEN p.PostTypeId=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as n_questions, SUM(CASE WHEN p.PostTypeId=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as n_answers, SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate > e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as n_posts_7d, SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate > e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as n_posts_30d, SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate > e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as n_posts_90d, SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate > e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as n_posts_365d, DATEDIFF('day', MAX(p.CreationDate), e.timestamp) as days_since_last_post FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = e.OwnerUserId AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: comment_stats
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(c.Id) as n_comments, SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate > e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as n_comments_7d, SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate > e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as n_comments_30d, SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate > e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as n_comments_90d, SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate > e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as n_comments_365d, DATEDIFF('day', MAX(c.CreationDate), e.timestamp) as days_since_last_comment FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.UserId = e.OwnerUserId AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: vote_stats
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(v.Id) as n_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate > e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as n_votes_30d, SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate > e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as n_votes_90d, DATEDIFF('day', MAX(v.CreationDate), e.timestamp) as days_since_last_vote FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN votes v ON v.UserId = e.OwnerUserId AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: badge_stats
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(b.Id) as n_badges, SUM(CASE WHEN b.Date > e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as n_badges_90d, SUM(CASE WHEN b.Class=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as n_badges_class1, SUM(CASE WHEN b.Class=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as n_badges_class2, SUM(CASE WHEN b.Class=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as n_badges_class3, DATEDIFF('day', MAX(b.Date), e.timestamp) as days_since_last_badge FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = e.OwnerUserId AND b.Date < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: votes_received
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(v.Id) as n_votes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as n_upvotes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as n_downvotes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate > e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as n_votes_received_90d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = e.OwnerUserId LEFT JOIN votes v ON v.PostId = p.Id AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: posthistory_stats
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(ph.Id) as n_posthistory, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.CreationDate > e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as n_posthistory_90d, DATEDIFF('day', MAX(ph.CreationDate), e.timestamp) as days_since_last_posthistory FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN postHistory ph ON ph.UserId = e.OwnerUserId AND ph.CreationDate < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp
